name: Town dialogue facts
notes: mw-e39.6: world-state facts read and written by the Briar Glen character dialogues (Vane, the Pells, Juniper, Oswin, Duggan). vane.fate and tansy.saved are registered with the endings.

facts.description: Harrow Vane's Deepworks ledger (the horn-coin sales, bible 4.1 beat 6) is in the player's hands. Set by the Deepworks ledger pickup; read by the Vane confrontation (vane-bounty).
Duggan Marl has agreed to testify that Vane's foreman planted the goblin trinkets on orders (Framed in Brass, bible 6.1). Set by duggan-testimony; read by the Vane confrontation.

The Vesper Bell's original bronze tongue has been destroyed, so a recast is the only way to ring it true (bible 5.7). Set by the main quest when the tongue is lost; read by oswin-forge to offer the recast.
Oswin Brand has been commissioned to recast the Vesper Bell's tongue from his father's mould (imperfectly, bible 5.7). Set by oswin-forge.
Hollis Pell has handed over the Pell family Bible with Brother Anselm's letter (side quest The Name on the Bones, bible 6.1). Set by hollis-pell.
Hollis gave a sorcerer Tansy's library card (bible 5.5). Stand-in until the item exists. Set by hollis-pell.
Hollis gave a thief the bakery's spare key (bible 5.5). Stand-in until the item exists. Set by hollis-pell.
Juniper Fenn has told the player that her sleep-draughts make the song easier to follow (bible 5.6). Set by juniper-fenn.
